resources.string: Allow Nearby devices (Bluetooth) to find the derailleur and the board.
Derailleur: searching… move the bike to wake it
Board: connected, its buttons shift through the phone
Like a shifter, with its own address
Switch the board to shifter mode?\n\nThe board replaces your shifter: the derailleur has to be paired with the board, and your shifter stops working until you pair it again. The board restarts.

Switch the board to phone app mode?\n\nThe board connects to the derailleur like the Wheeltop app, and your shifter keeps working. If the derailleur was paired with the board, pair your shifter with it again. The board restarts.
Pair the board with the derailleur
The board forgets its derailleur and pairs with the nearest one.\n\nWake the derailleur by moving the bike and keep the board close to it.
1. Plug the charger into the derailleur for a second: it enters pairing mode.\n2. Within 8 seconds press "Press shifter button": it acts as a button press on the board.
